result.instructions: Tools for Bugsnag, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which errors got the most new users in the last 24 hours?"; "Show me the latest events for the checkout error and the stack trace of the newest one."; "Mark the payment timeout error as fixed and comment that the fix ships in 2.4.1.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bugsnag data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bugsnag_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bugsnag_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bugsnag_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bugsnag_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bugsnag_update_error
tools.title: Update an error
tools.description: Change one error: open (reopen), fix, ignore, snooze (with reopenRules), link_issue (needs issue_url) or unlink_issue. It changes the error status for the whole team. Data Access API: PATCH /projects/{project_id}/errors/{error_id}.

issue_url.description: Issue URL to link. Required for link_issue.
